The beauty's more than skin deep in
the new Boeing 767.
Its anatomy combines profit-making
features like fuel-conserving engines,
an efficient wing, electronic flight
control systems, and a passenger-
pleasing cabin.
And durability, the legacy of our
learning through millions of airline
flight hours experience.
Elegant on the outside, tough on
the inside. That's the anatomy of
a profitmaker.
